title: Workshop Production Run at the War Citadel (Krynn): 3,500 cr once; five batches of coolant fluid made by hand from liquid nitrogen and purified water bought there
note: Written by Mercury, 2026-11-24 07:19 UTC (orders ENT-085 block MERCURY: close the <80% alarms, F40; F23: the Krynn desk ships earned no XP since 02:00 UTC, their neon craft finds no neon ask: 'neon_gas: not bought; craft ionize_neon_gas: no inputs', route bursar-desk-krynn; F34 tier 2, paid once). The War Citadel's board (data/missions 07:06 UTC): Workshop Production Run, crafting, 3,500 cr, template workshop_production_run, craft 5 items by any recipe. 39 of the 42 traders docked there have no such reward booked (data/fleet/onetime.json 07:19 UTC). The book (table books 07:08 UTC): purified_water asked 52 x 11,620 (liquid_nitrogen asked 8 x 10,058, most of it our own desks' listings: the pilot's own stored nitrogen is withdrawn first, the buy tops up only what is missing); synthesize_coolant_fluid 3 nitrogen + 2 water -> 3 coolant, five runs about 650 cr; the War Citadel bids 262 x 7 for coolant, sold at 200 or more, the rest stored. The form of mission-workshop-production-run-grand (10 runs, 3,420 a run). Whether the board offers it to pilots not born Crimson is not known (Node Beta's offers it to its own empire only): one ship first, its RESULT read before a lift.
